Initial parallel all-target run and first focused serialized inspection fault test failed before expected durable startup. Same assertions/deadlines subsequently passed focused and in the complete final serialized suite. Original logs do not establish cause; the helper now reports fixture mode and actual result. No product retry, weaker assertion or timeout extension was introduced.

First complete smoke passed earlier families but strict runtime rejected an unexpected musical snapshot sibling. Inspection found active rsync scratch synchronization and upstream receiver temporary naming exactly matching the extra suffix; neither native provider nor fixture code produces it. This is strongly supported environment-interference inference, not PID attribution. Ptrace tracing was refused before native execution; the fresh native run outside synchronized scratch passed with four accepted output digests. Recursive inotify watches missed rapidly created nested directories, so snapshot lifecycle and writer attribution were not observed; that instrumentation limitation is retained. Final qualification used unsynchronized /tmp workspaces without weakening the gate or modifying production code.
